changes: City list unchanged: the 18 cities stay. The UK rework was announced on 19 Oct 2025 (SCS blog) and has not shipped as of Nov 2026. Updates 1.58 (Feb 2026, physics), 1.59 (May 2026, Benelux rework), 1.60 (Jun 2026, lighting and radio), 1.61 (17 Sep 2026, livestock trailer and proximity exploration) and 1.62 (5 Nov 2026, garages and DAF editions) contain no UK map rework. Leeds, Inverness (previewed 3 Jul 2026), Bristol (previewed Sep 2026) and the Edinburgh rebuild are therefore not added.

The radio_only candidates are not added: Belfast, Lisburn, Londonderry, Inverness, Perth, Oban, Fort William, Ullapool, Portree, Broadford, Thurso, Wick, Kirkwall, Stromness, Birsay, Evie, Fraserburgh, Dumfries, Stranraer, Holyhead, Fishguard, Canterbury, Chelmsford, Croydon, Portsmouth, Folkestone, St Helier and Trinity. Searches and the wiki's UK city list show only the 18 base cities. These names are ProMods cities or unreleased UK-rework cities. Folkestone is added as an alias of Dover, for its Eurotunnel terminal.

Added ferry Newcastle-upon-Tyne - Amsterdam (IJmuiden), 520 km, conf high. The wiki ferry table lists Newcastle - IJmuiden (Amsterdam) as a base-game route (16h30m, EUR 1,212, Euro Lines). The SCS blog of 2 Apr 2026 shows the IJmuiden ferry rebuilt in the Benelux rework as the link to the UK.
Grimsby-Esbjerg ferry: conf low -> high, km 650 -> 620. The wiki lists Hull (Grimsby) - Esbjerg (19h, Euro Lines / Polaris Lines, requires Scandinavia DLC).
Plymouth-Roscoff ferry: conf low -> high. The wiki lists Plymouth - Roscoff (7h, EUR 910) for the base game + Vive la France!.
Plymouth-Santander ferry: conf low -> high. The wiki lists Plymouth - Santander (18h, EUR 1,176) for the base game + Iberia. Portsmouth-Santander exists only in a mod.
Grimsby-Rotterdam ferry: conf medium -> high. The wiki lists Hull (Grimsby) - Europoort (Rotterdam) (11h, EUR 995, base game).

Felixstowe-Rotterdam ferry: km 200 -> 210 (real sea route about 214 km). The wiki confirms Harwich (Felixstowe) - Europoort (8h, EUR 960, base game). This also confirms the Harwich and Hull port-label aliases, so those notes are updated.

Notes updated on London-Plymouth (Bristol) and Sheffield-Newcastle (Leeds): both cities are UK-rework previews, not current vanilla cities. Road edges are not changed: no web evidence was found for or against them.
